description: Application to vary condition 1 (Approved Plans) of planning permission Ref: DM2023/01355 for the 'Demolition of existing two-storey side extension and erection of a  two-storey detached dwelling with roof accommodation, including a rear dormer and rooflights to the front roofslope. Extension of the existing dropped kerb and alterations to the front boundary wall, provision of parking at the front and refuse and cycle storage, and installation of Air Source Heat Pump' to allow for a two storey front extension, extension to dormer, increase to loft floor space, formation of a front entrance porch, provision of additional rooflights to front and rear roofslopes and alteration of render and fenestrations.
